title: 35 Quick Facts About GTA 6!
intro: 35 quick facts about GTA 6 — one week before launch. Let's go!
outro: That's 35 facts. Which one surprised you most? Tell me in the comments, and subscribe so you don't miss what comes next. See you in Leonida!

facts.head: Nov 19, 2026
facts.say: GTA 6 launches on November 19th, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S.

facts.head: Midnight unlock
facts.say: It unlocks at midnight local time, so players in the earliest time zones get in first.
The standard edition costs seventy-nine ninety-nine in the US, and the Ultimate Edition is ninety-nine ninety-nine.

facts.head: Preload: Nov 10
facts.say: Digital preloading opened on November 10th, more than a week early.

facts.head: 212 GB
facts.say: Clear some space: the console download is about 212 gigabytes.

facts.head: Digital first
facts.say: Launch is digital only. A physical disc version is planned for 2027.

facts.head: No PC yet
facts.say: There's no PC version at launch. PC players will have to wait.

facts.head: Xbox Cloud
facts.say: Xbox Cloud Gaming streams it from day one, even on the old Xbox One.

facts.head: Delayed twice
facts.say: The game was delayed twice: from fall 2025, to May 2026, and finally to November.

facts.head: "Final date"
facts.say: Take-Two's boss Strauss Zelnick said he's highly confident November 19th is the final date.

facts.head: 13-year wait
facts.say: GTA 5 came out in 2013, making this the longest wait between main games in the series.

facts.head: ~230 million
facts.say: GTA 5 has sold nearly 230 million copies. That's the bar GTA 6 has to beat.

facts.head: Feb 2022
facts.say: Rockstar first confirmed the game was in development in February 2022.

facts.head: The 2022 leak
facts.say: That September, about 90 early development clips leaked online in one of gaming's biggest leaks ever.

facts.head: Leonida
facts.say: The game is set in Leonida, a fictional state based on Florida.

facts.head: Vice City is back
facts.say: Its main city is Vice City, Rockstar's take on Miami, last visited in 2006.

facts.head: Grassrivers
facts.say: Grassrivers is a swampy wilderness inspired by the Everglades.

facts.head: Leonida Keys
facts.say: The Leonida Keys bring island beaches, boats and chaos by the sea.

facts.head: Mount Kalaga
facts.say: Mount Kalaga adds mountains and backcountry wilderness to explore.

facts.head: Port Gellhorn & Ambrosia
facts.say: Port Gellhorn and Ambrosia round out the regions shown so far.

facts.head: Jason & Lucia
facts.say: You play as two leads: Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos.

facts.head: A first for GTA
facts.say: Lucia is the first female lead of the modern GTA era.

facts.head: Bonnie & Clyde
facts.say: Their story is a Bonnie and Clyde style crime romance.

facts.head: It starts in prison
facts.say: The very first trailer opens with Lucia behind bars, in prison.

facts.head: A state-wide conspiracy
facts.say: The pair get pulled into a criminal conspiracy that stretches across the whole state.

facts.head: New faces
facts.say: Other characters include Boobie Ike, Dre'Quan Priest, Real Dimez, Raul Bautista and Cal Hampton.

facts.head: Released early
facts.say: Trailer one leaked, so Rockstar released it early, on December 5th, 2023.

facts.head: 90 million views
facts.say: It got over 90 million YouTube views in 24 hours, a Guinness World Record for a game reveal.

facts.head: Beat MrBeast
facts.say: That beat MrBeast's record of 59 million views in a day for a non-music video.

facts.head: 8.9M likes
facts.say: With 8.9 million likes, it also became the most liked game trailer on YouTube.

facts.head: Tom Petty
facts.say: The music was Tom Petty's 1989 song, Love Is a Long Road.

facts.head: Trailer 2
facts.say: Trailer two arrived on May 6th, 2025.

facts.head: 475 million
facts.say: Across all platforms it hit 475 million views in just 24 hours.

facts.head: Captured in-game
facts.say: Rockstar says trailer two was captured entirely in-game on a PlayStation 5.

facts.head: DualSense features
facts.say: On PS5 you get adaptive triggers, police radio through the controller speaker, and 3D audio.
